subject: Treat a replica with no known primary as owning no slots (#5184)
reason: The change is a NULL-pointer guard in clusterUpdateSlotsConfigWith() (cluster_legacy.c:3530), reached only via the cluster gossip bus and only when a LIVE replica's primary has been deleted from the nodes table (replicaof == NULL) while another primary claims a previously-unassigned slot. The only primitive that NULLs a replica's own replicaof is a handshake-node timeout, which requires CLUSTER REPLICATE <id> of a node whose ID is randomly generated by CLUSTER MEET; valkey.action.commands cannot read that ID from a reply and reuse it (its <node.N.id> placeholders only name managed nodes), CLUS
